name: citing or keyed article with no credited author
query: JSTOR citing articles (cites.source jstor) with no AUTHORED row; keyed article works with no AUTHORED row
cause: key_jstor_articles minted JSTOR items without crediting anyone; DOI routes credit only a claiming author

name: review with a printed reviewer and no person key
query: works with reviewer_names and no AUTHORED row
cause: key_jstor_reviews stored the printed name as a reviewer-name member and minted no name-only keys
fix: work-people reviewer role (printed institution as the strong fact)

name: work credited to fewer people than its author list (the record owner only)
query: works with an OpenAlex/Crossref/JSTOR author list where some names are credited and some are not
cause: ORCID-claim and DOI routes credit the claiming author only
fix: author role links; co-author mints (proposal) for historians' works

name: co-authored work absent from the graph
query: OpenAlex works of tied authors with no graph work; graph DOIs no OpenAlex/Crossref record covers
cause: harvests are History-scoped; the DOI lookup ran 2026-11-09; Crossref harvest holds History-citing journals only
fix: not fixed here: needs an ingest decision (works of keyed historians outside History; DOI lookup refresh)

name: one person on several keys blocking links
query: possible positions whose live candidates pass the duplicate-group test
cause: minting from names (review-credit, H-Net review credits, dissertation authors) before identifiers
fix: duplicate-group branch credits the representative meanwhile; candidate-duplicates.csv.gz for merging

name: one work on two keys (preprint and version, same title)
query: (person, normalised title) with two or more article/other/chapter work keys
cause: DOI routes mint per DOI (10.2196/preprints.46643 and 10.2196/46643); ORCID records list both
fix: not fixed: needs a work-dedupe rule (same title, same authors, preprint/version DOIs)

name: two authored claims for one person and work
cause: two routes (ORCID and DOI/LC) each minted a claim
fix: explorer lists the work once and counts distinct works; key log unchanged

name: article/other work without a journal although a record would supply it
query: kind article/other, journal null, and an OpenAlex/JSTOR record held for the work
cause: works minted from ORCID records carry no journal member
fix: not fixed: a journal backfill from the records

name: non-historian co-author with no node
query: co-author mentions in state none on works of historian keys
cause: only persons met in history sources were keyed

name: bridge lost because one unkeyed co-author is split across papers
query: same full name, co-authors of different historians, no shared fact
fix: possible-same marks; extra facts tested on ORCID mentions

name: work known only from one ORCID record (no DOI): no author list to read
query: works whose anchors are all orcid-work:
fix: OpenAlex records matched by title+year+author family (openalex_people_works) read as author lists

name: the reviewed book's author printed as the author of a review record
query: key-log AUTHORED on a review work by the author of the book it reviews; linker rows refused by the book-author check
cause: Crossref/OpenAlex review records carry the book author (source metadata)
fix: own_book_check refuses such links (state none / possible); the key-log claims are listed, not withdrawn

name: the same name printed with curly and straight apostrophes lands in two families
an OpenAlex author id that joins two people
query: links whose only tie is an OpenAlex author id carrying another ORCID than the key's

name: rarity measured in History used for a work outside History
query: rarity-only links on OpenAlex records fetched by DOI outside the History harvest
fix: a second fact is required there
